_comment: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE ONLY — obviously-fake topics/projects throughout. The real claude-context-topic-rules.json carries private instance routing data (real decision topics from the claude_context database, real project identifiers) and is gitignored, never committed. E-11 (CONSOLIDATION-RUNBOOK.md §6.1(e) amendment, memory-manager#11(e)): claude_context is a shared DB spanning multiple real projects with ZERO topic-prefix convention (plain-English titles, not the `pwa-etl-<kebab>`-style dash-prefixed topics claude_policy_framework's decisions use) — D-1/D-10's dash-token classifier cannot apply verbatim. This file's classifier is CONTAINS-typed instead: an ordered rule list, each rule a case-insensitive substring match against the topic (lowercased, trimmed), first-match-wins. A topic matching zero rules falls to `unmatched-<slugified-first-word>` (never guessed, never silently dropped — mirrors D-1/D-10's fallback exactly, just keyed on a word instead of a dash-token). This classifier applies to claude_context's `decisions` table ONLY — see migrate-04-absorb-pipeline-tables.js's header comment for why claude_context's OTHER tables (gotchas/research/tasks/code_index/sessions, none of which carry a per-row topic/project hint column at all) are routed differently, via pipeline-db-project-map.json's DB-level default instead.

rules.note: example row 1 — acme-widget-portal-shaped topics are ALWAYS excluded, regardless of what other rules exist, per E-11's fix. acme-widget-portal is itself a separate OWNER-REVIEW database (§16.3, V6) — its content must never be silently migrated as real project data through the claude_context side door.

example row 2 — a recognizable keyword cluster for one thematically-coherent but NOT owner-confirmed project, routed to one consolidated unmatched-* review bucket rather than fragmenting into one bucket per topic.
example row 3 — same target as row 2, different keyword, same review bucket.
